_comment: Copy to ~/.config/capocantiere/workers.json and keep only what you change: missing keys use the built-in defaults. Keys starting with _ are comments. Environment variables CAPOCANTIERE_<WORKER>_<SETTING> (e.g. CAPOCANTIERE_VIBE_MAX_PRICE=1) override this file.
_order: Preference order when no worker is requested (the session default from /capocantiere:use goes first).
_fallback: On a quota/rate-limit error or an exhausted budget, move the job to the next worker.
_max_parallel: Jobs running at once across all workers (each worker also has its own max_parallel).

copilot._comment: GitHub Copilot CLI. Logs in with `copilot login`. daily_budget counts runs (each run costs AI credits / premium requests). deny_tools are always denied while auto-approving in the job's worktree.

vibe._comment: Mistral Vibe CLI. Signs in with your Mistral account (run `vibe` once; the Free plan works) or MISTRAL_API_KEY. max_price is a USD cap per run computed from vibe's configured prices: an extra guard only. Set outside_workdir = "deny" in ~/.vibe/config.toml.

agy._comment: Antigravity CLI. DISABLED by default: running `agy -p` inside third-party agents is not supported on consumer plans and can get the account suspended. Enable it only with an API key, never with the subscription login.
agy._auth: api_key: Gemini API key from AI Studio in GEMINI_API_KEY (export it, or set it under env); adc: Google Cloud Application Default Credentials; login: the signed-in Google account (NOT recommended, see above).
